summary: Scans a 3D occupancy grid of 16-bit cells located via *(this+0x1A4)+0x18 to tighten an axis-aligned bounding box held in a2[0..5]. Shrinks minX/maxX, minY/maxY, minZ/maxZ inward until each face meets an occupied (non-zero) cell, writing the tightened bounds back into a2[0..5]. Computes a squared-magnitude descriptor into a2[6], counts all remaining occupied cells into v44, stores the count in a2[7], and returns it.

operations.description: Load grid row-pointer array base v28 = *(DWORD*)(*(DWORD*)(a1+0x1A4) + 0x18); rows are indexed as v28 + 4*coord.
Read initial bounding box extents from a2: a2[0]=minX, a2[1]=maxX, a2[2]=minY, a2[3]=maxY, a2[4]=minZ, a2[5]=maxZ into locals.
Only scan the X direction if minX (a2[0]) is less than maxX (a2[1]).
Shrink minX: advance X while the whole row slab at that X is empty (all cells zero); when an occupied cell is found, write tightened minX back to *a2.
Shrink maxX: step X down from maxX while its slab is empty; on first occupied cell write tightened maxX to a2[1].
Only scan the Y direction if minY (a2[2]) is less than maxY (a2[3]).
Shrink minY: advance Y while the row at that Y is empty; write tightened minY to a2[2] on first occupied cell.
Shrink maxY: step Y down from maxY while empty; write tightened maxY to a2[3] on first occupied cell.
Only scan the Z direction if minZ (a2[4]) is less than maxZ (a2[5]).
Shrink minZ: advance Z while the column at that Z is empty; write tightened minZ to a2[4] on first occupied cell.
Shrink maxZ: step Z down from maxZ while empty; write tightened maxZ to a2[5] on first occupied cell.
Compute a2[6] = 16*(maxX-minX)*16*(maxX-minX) + 12*(maxY-minY)*12*(maxY-minY) + 8*(maxZ-minZ)*8*(maxZ-minZ), a scaled squared-extent descriptor.
Iterate every cell within the tightened bounding box; increment v44 for each non-zero 16-bit cell.
Store the occupied-cell count into a2[7].
Return v44 (occupied-cell count) as the function result.
